name: Context selection ranking accuracy and card-quality outcome
purpose: One balanced number per arm (accuracy, cost and time, with weights fixed before any arm was scored in esoi.toml [balance.context_selection]) that BUILDS ON the hub's metrics and does not re-run them: the hub's context_retrieval metric (file, topic, orientation and no-context requests over the pinned corpus, with the hub's cases and scorer) and, as its own solution, the hub's cards_from_files metric (building a store from source files), each at the share esoi.toml [builds_on.context_selection.*] states. An arm named hub_<x> IS the hub's arm <x> and reuses the hub's recorded per-case results while they are current (same arm, same cases digest, unchanged code); any other arm is run through the hub's own scorer by evaluation/components/context_selection/foundation_adapter.py; a stale hub result is never mixed in, so a new hub case kind or a scorer fix reaches this number the next time it is run. QAR keeps no copy of those cases or scorers. What QAR adds is what only QAR can measure: when the private dataset named by QAR_PRIVATE_CONTEXT_DATASET is present, real inputs with labelled candidate items (QAR_PRIVATE_CONTEXT_DATASET may name several folders separated by the path separator, each loaded when it holds cases; items carry source, author, channel, recency, quest-relation and quest-title metadata that is rendered at the start of the item's card, items with a path are given that path in the throwaway corpus, and the request's quest and goal titles lead the task text; scored as an arm's cards over the case's own items; accuracy is the harmonic mean of needed-item recall and one minus noise; the size of what is selected is charged as cost; the row note also reports edit_recall, the share of needed edit-target items selected, and cross_quest_recall, the share of needed items from outside the request's own quest or goal selected, so a selector that fences items by quest scope scores 0 there). The real inputs carry the share the hub's metrics leave (about a third) and follow the dataset manifest's proportions of self-contained, single-item and several-item needs. Reading the candidate items from the Quest server is source access: metered per request, priced at the constants of [balance.context_selection.source_access], and bounded by gates (no full scan of a source, a per-request read budget, nothing read outside the Quest scope) that may tighten the hub's and never loosen them (esoi rule S47). Cost is model dollars plus a store charge that grows with the share of the card limit the arm's store fills. Every arm makes zero model calls. A row states in its details how many cases of each source were present, never case text, and its cases digest covers the private files when present (private:absent otherwise). Outcome arm (evaluation/components/card_quality): after cards are learned from three finished tasks, a new query selects the right collection with its references resolved fresh, without spraying every card or leaking an unrelated one. Second outcome arm (evaluation/components/claude_code_ab): does the warm hint help an agent find the file? Claude Code with the hint against Claude Code alone, on the same which-file tasks; the offline arm scores what the hint would contain Read in this direction: raise the rate at which the right file or card is ranked first and within the first few, lower the tokens spent on context, keep unrelated cards out, and keep the rendered view stable between identical selections so prompt caches hold. On the grown task set the hybrid ties the keyword arm alone on strict top 3 and the vector arm adds recall only past the third card, never rank, so a tie is not a win. The embedder is the small local one and the tasks are synthetic; whether the hint helps an agent (the claude_code_ab live arms) is unmeasured.
record: The pass rate, passed cases out of cases run, of each implementation on the same cases, with the recorded cost as the tie-break; each run is one row of the results file pinned to the commit and the cases hash, and the leaderboard compares rows only when the hash matches.
cascading_conditionals: idea [kind=idea | scale=esoi/idea-rating-scale.md | min-pass-rate=0.75 | when=a new alternative is described: rate its description on the five questions of the scale before it is built] > offline [sample=full | real=no | gate=all-pass | when=the hybrid_union offline arm of context_selection runs the whole case set with no model call] > one [sample=sample:1 | real=yes | gate=all-pass | when=a single real case runs end to end and is hand-read: esoi run claude_code_ab --impl warm_claude --only CAB-001 --max-calls 3] > live [real=yes | max-age-days=90 | when=a person approved the spend under the metric run policy]
command: esoi run context_selection --impl hybrid_union; esoi run card_quality --impl seeded_keyword_store; esoi run claude_code_ab --impl idf_hint

name: Pointer-resolution safety over offline cases
purpose: offline cases: built-in note and file resolvers, consumer resolvers (object and callable, override), unresolved-pointer lines for every type, one failing resolver costs nothing else, abridged summaries, character budget, item cap, pointer only for files Consumer data layers are scripted fakes.

name: Mixed card and specification selection, with both existing selection metrics held
purpose: Measures whether one search puts the right cards and the right records in view together. Runs on a combined labelled set of requests and on the existing context_selection and spec_selection cases as its two halves, so a merged pipeline is compared with the two separate ones on the same cases. The combined set is evaluation/components/context_and_specs (generic fixture cards beside the spec_selection fixture index, with a problem and an intent that no solution serves and a fixture tag), with three kinds of request: ones whose right answer mixes a source (a file, a note, a conversation) and the solution, problem or metric it served; ones whose best match is a problem or an intent with no solution yet, labelled with that record and "no solution yet"; and ones that match only an ideal or a metric, labelled with the record a link should bring. The mixed set also holds a card alone, a solution alone, a runbook, a file with a failing metric, paraphrases, a past conversation, a change named by a tag (R3), two overlapping solutions (R1), an unrelated request, a note with its problem and an implementation's name; an ambiguous request is live only. The offline arms call no model. The merged arm runs on the two halves as esoi run spec_selection --impl solutions_and_problems_with_links and esoi run context_selection --impl solutions_and_problems_with_links, free arms only, compared with the best free arm already recorded there (lexical_vector and hybrid_union or idf_docstrings); the gated paid spec arm is not re-run for it.
record: Per arm on the same cases: the mixed-case pass rate (every expected card and record present, no more than the ceiling returned, the "no solution yet" mark where expected), the spec_selection balanced score and the context_selection pass rate on their own cases, and model calls per assembly; one row per run pinned to the commit and the cases hash. An arm that drops either existing metric does not win.
cascading_conditionals: offline [sample=full | real=no | gate=all-pass | when=the solutions_and_problems_with_links offline arm of context_and_specs runs the whole case set with no model call]
command: esoi run context_and_specs --impl solutions_and_problems_with_links; esoi run spec_selection --impl solutions_and_problems_with_links; esoi run context_selection --impl solutions_and_problems_with_links

name: Semantic recall and query latency on the synthetic handbook
purpose: Labelled card in the top three over the questions (most of them paraphrases) on the synthetic handbook, live embedded QdrantVectorStore, and query latency (p50 and p95 milliseconds, each within the cap written in the case data) at a fixed corpus size with deterministic filler cards; the query is embedded by the model for real Read in this direction: raise recall of the labelled item within the first few results, hold query latency inside an interactive budget at a fixed corpus size, and avoid re-embedding unchanged items. The embedder is the local bge-small, not the deployed one, and latency is of the embedded local store on this host, not a Qdrant server over a network.
record: The pass rate, passed cases out of cases run, of each implementation on the same cases, with the recorded cost as the tie-break; each run is one row of the results file pinned to the commit and the cases hash, and the leaderboard compares rows only when the hash matches.
disadvantages: A card is embedded from its first 2000 characters, so VEC-012 (answer at the end of a long card) misses.
